name: PGSS510_U4501
description: In October 1943, Walterwerke submitted a proposal to the Kriegsmarine for a submarine featuring a closed-cycle Walter system engine fueled by hydrogen peroxide. This engine was designed to operate effectively whether the submarine was on the surface or submerged. The various sections of the submarine hulls had to be manufactured in different shipyards, and sections for four submarines—designated U-4501 to U-4504—were produced before the war reached its conclusion.

consumables.name: Damage Control Party
consumables.description:
Extinguishes fires, removes instances of flooding, and repairs damaged modules.
Prevents enemy acoustic torpedoes from homing.

consumables.name: Hydrophone
consumables.description: Highlights the positions of ships and submarines on the surface or at periscope depth that are beyond spotting range. Ship positions are ascertained at the moment you activate the consumable.

consumables.name: Submarine Surveillance
consumables.description: Detects submarines at maximum and periscope depths.

consumables.name: Reserve Battery Unit
consumables.description: Dive capacity does not deplete when the consumable is active.

consumables.name: Repair Party
consumables.description: Partially restores the ship's HP by repairing any light damage.
